properties.displayName: Public network access on Azure SQL Database should be disabled
properties.description: Disabling the public network access property improves security by ensuring your Azure SQL Database can only be accessed from a private endpoint. This configuration denies all logins that match IP or virtual network based firewall rules. Enabled=true checks all matching in-scope resources; false skips the check.

metadata.description: Start in audit mode. Only effects supported by the source definition are available.
True checks every matching resource within the assignment scope; false skips the check. Use assignment exclusions or exemptions for exceptions. Select true or false; defaults to true.
